I want support - the Bitfortun BS-2 on order Shop···· didn't work out of the box and now has completely failed

Sorry, that's a bad start with it. A shipped unit that's failed goes through RMA: fill the intake form and you'll get a prepaid return label. Processing takes up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

One thing I have to ask: was the unit overclocked or modified at all? Overclocked units aren't covered by warranty or RMA.

Good, then it's covered. Go ahead and fill the form with order Shop···· and describe both the out-of-box fault and the full failure, and they'll send a prepaid label.

One quick check first: does anything light up or spin when you plug it in? If it's completely dead at the wall it's often the PSU, and we can ship a replacement PSU on its own without you returning the miner.

Then the PSU is likely fine and it's the unit itself, so RMA is the route. Fill the form with Shop····, they'll send the prepaid label, and processing is up to 10 days after it lands at the warehouse.

If you want a second pair of eyes before you box it up, JD is on our Discord and answers fast: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate. Does it show any status on its dashboard, or nothing at all?
